note: Doctrinal templates for the IPB pages of the Ground Guide's Extended View (IPB_Plan.md §6.7, Phase 7; book s3 para 2 pp 22-32). A doctrinal template shows the enemy's deployment without terrain or weather (book p 22); laid along an avenue on the area read it becomes a situation template: each element is checked on its own mover's ground, moved to the nearest usable ground, and known positions are never moved (book p 23). Templates are rough approximations, not fact; over-reliance invites deception (book p 32). Basis: D = read from the source (cited), D? = read from a figure image, not yet confirmed by the user, T = typical public figure, E = my estimate or placement (to confirm), U = the user's decision.
handling: Figures read from KYE-2019 (SECRET) and from restricted Pakistan Army pamphlets (C&SC IPB book; Desert Warfare; Operations of War Vol I and II; Infantry Battalion in Battle). No text is copied, only figures and short rules with their pages. Keep this file under the same handling terms before it goes outside the owner's own systems.

mountainTest.rule: The mountain template is picked (Auto) when the ground within 5 km of the position rises 400 m or more.

movers.note: How each kind of element is judged: armour and mech on the IPB coding for that mover; dismounted on the dismounted coding; guns on the mech coding and never on a hilltop (book p 23: 'artillery on hilltops'); fixed elements (objectives, crossings) are not moved.

unusableShare.note: An element whose footprint is more than a quarter NO-GO for its mover is moved.

hilltop.rule: A gun area is on a hill when it stands in the upper 40 % of the ground 1 km round, where that ground rises 30 m or more: moved to lower ground out of view.

searchM.note: The nearest usable ground is looked for within 3 km; beyond that the element is marked 'no usable ground'.

knownM.note: An enemy symbol already on the map within 1.5 km of an element of its kind takes that element's place and is never moved (book p 23).
